criteria.observation: Assesses the current candidate against requested scope and captured state with cited evidence.
Identifies permitted non-mutating preparation with the corresponding commands while a write is blocked.
At the proposed write, compares the approved plan and the live state identity, explains the effect of changed prerequisites and how to prepare a fresh decision.
Binds each proposed forward and rollback mutation to the authorized target, exact plan and appropriate approver.
Uses the trigger, observed post-change traffic and target to decide if service recovered and retains diagnostic evidence; a repository change alone earns no recovery credit.
Applies the documented promotion trigger, destination, owner and available evidence without assuming a completed operation.
